name: trading
description: Handmade Binance trading interface with a Fastify backend, SolidJS UI, and reusable bot package.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @trading/server" "npm run dev -w @trading/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @trading/bot-algo && npm run build -w @trading/server && npm run build -w @trading/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @trading/bot-algo && npm run typecheck -w @trading/server && npm run typecheck -w @trading/web
scripts.mlp:bootstrap: uv venv --python python3 .venv-ml && uv pip sync --python .venv-ml/bin/python ml/requirements.txt
scripts.mlp:dataset: TMPDIR=/tmp node scripts/run-node-with-ml-libs.mjs node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/build-mlp-dataset.ts --plan ml/training-plan.json
scripts.mlp:features: TMPDIR=/tmp node scripts/run-node-with-ml-libs.mjs node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/build-mlp-dataset.ts --plan ml/training-plan.json --refresh-features true
scripts.mlp:refine: TMPDIR=/tmp node scripts/run-node-with-ml-libs.mjs node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/build-mlp-dataset.ts --plan ml/training-plan.json --refinement-pass 1
